# Glimdock (`glimdock`)

Glimdock nodes: the telemetry snapshot behind the charts and the health page, and pairing of the node's own monitoring agents. Read-only.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/glimdock`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/glimdock/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/glimdock/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | local network |
| Classes | `telemetry` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | yes |
| Guided setup | yes |

## What it reaches

- HTTP to the device, port 80
- HTTPS to the device, port 443

Nothing at all while the hub is in dry-run.

## Settings

| Key | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | Node URL | URL (http, https) | yes |  | The node's base URL: scheme, host and port only, such as http://192.0.2.10:8080. |
| `snapshot_path` | Snapshot path | text, at most 256 | yes |  | The path of the node's snapshot endpoint, such as /api/snapshot. A plain absolute path. |
| `pairing_path` | Agent pairing path | text, at most 256 | no |  | The path of the node's agent pairing endpoint. Without it, pairing an agent says it is not set up. |

## Secrets

| Slot | Label | Required | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | Access token | yes | The node's reader token. Sent only as `Authorization: Bearer` in a header. |

## Custom actions

None: it offers the standard actions of its classes.

## Words for voice

- Heard `glim dock`, meant `glimdock`
- `glimdock` names the class `telemetry`
